title: pimelea curviflora subsp. gracilis
intro: Pimelea curviflora subsp. gracilis, commonly known as Curly Rice Flower, is a species of flowering plant in the family Thymelaeaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Pimelea curviflora subsp. gracilis include its ability to reduce inflammation and fight off infections, although more research is needed to confirm its effectiveness. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
